title.en: the plainpalais brocante and flea market.
title.de: brocante und flohmarkt auf der plaine de plainpalais.

line.en: a weekly vide-greniers and flea market, open 06:00 to 18:00 in winter hours, free entry. a good saturday morning to walk round and browse.
line.de: ein wöchentlicher brocante- und flohmarkt, winterzeiten 06:00 bis 18:00 uhr, eintritt frei. ein guter samstagvormittag zum stöbern.
line.tr: haftalık bir brocante ve bit pazarı, kış saatlerinde 06:00 ile 18:00 arası açık, giriş ücretsiz. cumartesi sabahı dolaşıp bakınmak için iyi bir zaman.

sparks.why: Brocante de Plainpalais listed for Sat 28.11.2026, 6h to 18h winter hours, free entry, per vide-greniers.org and brocabrac.fr; the series recurs weekly, so the date was checked against the calendar.
